'''Sacred rocks''' were special stones on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Marlox]] and his guards captured the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] while she was collecting sacred rocks.
